paper.title: A Decade of Event-Based Vision: A Survey of 1200 Papers
paper.abstract: We survey the past decade of event-based vision, organising 1,200 papers across feature tracking, optical flow, reconstruction, depth, SLAM, segmentation, classification, control, datasets, simulators, and hardware. We trace 38 sub-trends, identify 14 open problems, and provide a dataset taxonomy with download links. This is the first community-driven update to the 2020 TPAMI survey and includes papers up to 2026.

digest.tldr: Comprehensive survey of 1,200 event-based vision papers over the last decade.
key_contributions: Highlights 14 open problems in the field.
Provides a dataset taxonomy with download links.
Updates the 2020 TPAMI survey with recent findings.
digest.relation_to_prior_work: This survey builds on the 2020 TPAMI survey by expanding its scope to include recent developments and a larger number of papers, providing a more comprehensive overview of the field.
digest.eccg_relevance: This survey is crucial for the event-camera community as it synthesizes a decade of research, highlights emerging trends, and identifies challenges that need addressing, fostering collaboration and innovation.
open_questions: What specific methodologies are most effective in recent studies?
How can the identified open problems be prioritized for research?
What are the implications of the dataset taxonomy for future experiments?
